steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 50
steps.text: In this C2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I finally got used to waking up early.
I always procrastinate on Sunday nights.
My daily commute takes about an hour.
